QuestInfo.name: Samuel's Revelation of the Second Truth
QuestInfo.parent: The Ultimate Stage of the Pirate
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2081500##k says that he will tell me the Second Truth and wants me to come back and talk to him when I'm ready.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p2081500##k has told me the story of the Holychorus, the Second Truth. He said there is one more story to be told.

0.0: The second story I want to share with you involves corals that grow in the sea water. Are you interested?

yes.0: Great. I think you are more than capable of hearing the truth. Let me know when you are ready.

no.0: Whatever happened to the courage you summoned to see me?

1.0: Have you been to the Aquarium, located deep in the sea? The Aquarium is a mysterious area that floats above the the deep canyon. Aren't you curious to find out how Aquarium stays afloat?
1.1: At the bottom of the Deep Sea canyon Aquarium floats above, there is a self-growing stone called the #bHolychorus#k. No one knows how it ended up there, or how it started growing, but it has been there for a long, long time.
1.2: #bHolychorus#k has the mysterious ability to purify the ocean, and this power allows Aqua Road to stay clean, while keeping Aquarium afloat above the canyon. Without the #bHolychorus#k, the whole sea will be blackened.

yes.0: The second batch of truth ends here. When you are ready to hear the last story, let me know.
